title: First Banking Dataset
business_scenario: Inspect a small deposits and account ownership dataset before building governed BI metrics.

inputs.description: Planned static deposits dataset with Romanian branch geography, RON and EUR balances, and ownership rows.
date_semantics: balance_date is a daily snapshot date.
opened_date is an account lifecycle date.
inputs.grain: One row per account per business_date in account_daily_balances.

outputs.description: SQL that profiles rows, currencies, branches, and snapshot dates.
Query output with counts and basic balance totals for the synthetic dataset.

checks.description: Result must not expose raw customer or account identifiers.

questions.prompt: What is the intended grain of the deposit_balances table?

options.label: One row per account per balance date.
One row per customer per balance date.
One row per branch per month.

questions.explanation: Daily balances are semi-additive snapshots at account-date grain.

criteria: SQL checks pass for required columns and forbidden sensitive fields.

hints.text: Start by counting rows and distinct values before joining ownership rows.

title: Looker Studio Evidence Pattern
business_scenario: Practice collecting inspectable evidence from a browser-based BI workflow without storing credentials in the app.

required_tools.name: Google Cloud Console
required_tools.purpose: Optional cloud-applied track for BigQuery UI work in a browser.
required_tools.platform_notes: Browser UI only; no Google Cloud CLI.

required_tools.name: Looker Studio
required_tools.purpose: Optional report-building evidence through the browser UI.
required_tools.platform_notes: Browser UI only; no service account keys or app-stored credentials.

inputs.description: Tutorial instructions for using a serving view as the dashboard source.
Optional browser UI workflow in BigQuery and Looker Studio.

outputs.description: Pasted evidence that names the serving view, freshness label, and visible dashboard metric.

checks.description: Evidence mentions the serving view instead of an ad hoc source table.
Evidence includes a visible freshness or source cutoff label.

questions.prompt: What should the static app store for this cloud evidence task?
questions.explanation: Cloud work happens outside the static app; credentials must not be collected or stored.

evidence.description: Learner-provided note with serving view name, freshness label, and dashboard metric.

criteria: Credential storage question is answered correctly.

hints.text: Evidence should describe what is visible without pasting secrets, tokens, or private URLs.

title: Orientation Quiz
business_scenario: Confirm the training boundary before working with synthetic Romanian banking BI examples.

inputs.description: Existing docs, regulations, and tutorials rendered in the static app.

outputs.description: Browser-local answers to orientation and synthetic-data questions.

checks.description: Learner confirms that only synthetic banking data belongs in this project.
Learner confirms the default challenge path requires no installed local tools.
Learner identifies sensitive fields that should not appear in BI serving outputs.
Learner confirms the number of quiz question types supported by this runtime.

questions.prompt: Which data is allowed in Looker BI Gym challenge files?

options.label: Small synthetic banking data created for training.
A masked production sample with credentials removed.

questions.explanation: Challenge files must use synthetic data only.

questions.prompt: What should a browser-only challenge declare for required tools?
questions.explanation: Browser-only tasks explicitly declare required_tools as none.

questions.prompt: Which fields are sensitive serving-output fields in the seed deposits dataset?
questions.explanation: Account IDs, customer IDs, and synthetic IBANs are intentionally marked sensitive.

questions.prompt: How many quiz question types does the first quiz runtime support?
questions.explanation: The runtime supports multiple choice, select all, and numeric answers.

hints.text: Check the project constraints shown on the home page.
